Messages.Author: delangen
Messages.Body:
Just a little nugget that might need an addendum:

This scenario has come up a few times:

My untap, I have dreams of sphinx in play with two counters on, I tap for two extra cards for the turn and burn it....them during my master phase play another dreams of sphinx and tap it for another two cards for a total of +4 hand size for the turn... now this doesn't break any rules I know of, but sounds like there should be an errata or addendum

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: You did everything alright! Double Sphinx is always good!

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
> delangen wrote:
> sounds like there should be an errata or addendum
>
If you are worried about this breaking the game, don't worry - it's not actually so easy to pull off (you need to have an uncontested dreams with two counters at the start of your turn, and have another dreams in your hand, and have nothing better to do with your master phase action), plus it doesn't give much more advantage than, say, a visit from the capuchin.
